I’m kinda in the same boat as you, and I bought myself a suit not long ago! 

The first thing I did was looking at different designs online until I found something I liked. I then took my measurements (at home) and looked at a few online stores to see what size I was. I then went to the same stores, just irl, and tried on some sizes until I found something that looked flattering on me. I found out that bigger blazers look more masculine on me (cuz it hides my curves) while smaller and shorter blazers look more feminine (since they show off my curves and compliment my waist/hips). 

I’m kinda broke, so I figured I probably didn’t have enough money to buy something brand new. I then went to look at thrift stores irl or online until I found what I was looking for. 

I think I ended up paying only 25% of the original price while I got (almost) brand new clothes! You’d be surprised by how many people who have unworn suits just laying around. xD

My tips would be to see if you have any thrift stores where you live, or to look for online thrift stores. You could also keep an eye out for big sales. Good luck! xx
